title: 伸縮門扉（アコーディオン門扉）
description: 住宅や駐車場の入口に使う、アルミ製の伸縮門扉です。ジグザグに開いた縦材13本、菱形に交差する格子の斜材、上部の横材、各縦材の下のキャスター、固定側と受け側の柱、取っ手、地面のガイドを造形しています。部分的に伸ばした状態の静的形状で、伸縮・施錠の動作は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）3.700 × 1.400 × 0.300 m、14,756三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An aluminium accordion sliding gate for house and car park entrances. It models thirteen zigzag verticals, diagonal lattice bars forming diamonds, top rails, casters under each vertical, a fixed post and a latch post with handle, and a ground guide. It is a static, partly extended shape; extending, folding and locking motion are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 3.700 × 1.400 × 0.300 m; 14,756 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
